subject: EVS
learningObjectives: Respect all types of work (Dignity of Labour)
misconceptions: Cleaning is the job of only specific communities

practiceExercises.question: Who said "Every person should do every kind of work"?
practiceExercises.hint: He is the Father of our Nation.
practiceExercises.explanation: Gandhiji believed that no work is low and everyone should clean their own surroundings.

flashcards.back: Unfair practice of treating some people as low
Architect of Indian Constitution who fought against bias

revisionNotes: Cleanliness is next to Godliness. Respect everyone who works for us.
commonMistakes: Thinking certain jobs are "dirty" and should be avoided
